buttons.label: add button
buttons.tooltip: Add another launcher button for one of the built-in Blender actions.

buttons.label: Base
buttons.tooltip: Store the current selected-object bounds as the Smart Axis baseline.

buttons.label: X
buttons.tooltip: Cycle Smart Axis X between none, minus, and plus pinning.

buttons.label: Y
buttons.tooltip: Cycle Smart Axis Y between none, minus, and plus pinning.

buttons.label: Z
buttons.tooltip: Cycle Smart Axis Z between none, minus, and plus pinning.

buttons.label: Live
buttons.tooltip: Toggle Smart Axis live pinning.

buttons.label: Cursor Center Hole
buttons.tooltip: With one hole wall face selected in Edit Mode, finds the center point and moves the 3D cursor to it.

buttons.label: save stl
buttons.tooltip: Export the selected mesh objects to the active organization profile's STL destination as a uniquely named STL.

buttons.label: save png
buttons.tooltip: Render the active selected object from the current scene camera to 01 src\00 assets\01 images as a transparent PNG cropped exactly to the visible object bounds.

buttons.label: cura
buttons.tooltip: Export the selected mesh objects as STL files and add them to Cura.

buttons.label: orca
buttons.tooltip: Export the selected mesh objects as STL files and add them to Orca.

buttons.label: make layers
buttons.tooltip: Create Live, Snapshots, Trash, and Archive if missing.

buttons.label: sort
buttons.tooltip: Sort by visibility: visible objects become Live, matching invisible family objects become Snapshots as s#, and other invisible objects become Trash as t#.

buttons.label: Sort Live
buttons.tooltip: Move every currently hidden object under Live into Trash.

buttons.label: snapshot
buttons.tooltip: Save the selected Live objects into Snapshots.

buttons.label: back
buttons.tooltip: Move current Live to Trash and restore the latest snapshot for the selected target.

buttons.label: restore
buttons.tooltip: Copy selected snapshot, trash, or archive objects into Live and move the current Live version to Trash first.

buttons.label: add to live
buttons.tooltip: Copy selected snapshot, trash, or archive objects into Live without replacing the current Live version.

buttons.label: trash
buttons.tooltip: Move selected objects into Trash.

buttons.label: archive
buttons.tooltip: Copy selected objects into Archive.

buttons.label: empty trash
buttons.tooltip: Delete everything inside Trash.

buttons.label: new collection
buttons.tooltip: Prompt for a name and create a new child collection near the selected object.

buttons.label: empty collections
buttons.tooltip: Delete empty collections while keeping the system roots.

buttons.label: cycle collection
buttons.tooltip: Use the selected object's collection and show one direct object at a time while selecting it.

buttons.label: cycle versions
buttons.tooltip: With one selected Live object, cycle Live and snapshot versions one visible object at a time.

buttons.label: cycle versions back
buttons.tooltip: With one selected Live object, cycle Live and snapshot versions one visible object at a time.

buttons.label: cycle versions forward
buttons.tooltip: With one selected Live object, cycle Live and snapshot versions one visible object at a time.

buttons.label: baseline visibility
buttons.tooltip: Record the objects currently visible in the active view layer.

buttons.label: restore visibility
buttons.tooltip: Hide every object in the active view layer except the objects recorded by Baseline Visibility.

buttons.label: rename selected
buttons.tooltip: Rename all selected Blender objects in one prompt.

buttons.label: Cube
buttons.tooltip: Low poly cube.

buttons.label: Cylinder
buttons.tooltip: Low poly cylinder.

buttons.label: Sphere
buttons.tooltip: Low poly sphere.

buttons.label: Triangle
buttons.tooltip: Low poly triangular prism.

buttons.label: Cone
buttons.tooltip: Low poly cone.

buttons.label: obj import
buttons.tooltip: Import an OBJ, rotate it -90 degrees on X, scale it 10x, and apply transforms. (from Illustrator export)

buttons.label: split
buttons.tooltip: Split joined or physically separated parts into disconnected objects and set each new origin to geometry.

buttons.label: transform
buttons.tooltip: Apply location, rotation, and scale to all selected objects in Object Mode.

buttons.label: lithophane
buttons.tooltip: Pick one or more images in Blender, create DPI-sized planes, and turn them into lithophanes automatically.

buttons.label: origin_geo
buttons.tooltip: Set each selected object's origin to its geometry center in Object Mode.

buttons.label: Grid
buttons.tooltip: Toggle Grid snap between moving the selection to the grid and moving the cursor to the grid.

buttons.label: Cursor
buttons.tooltip: Toggle Cursor snap between moving the selection to the cursor and moving the cursor to the selection.

buttons.label: Active
buttons.tooltip: Toggle Active snap between moving the selection to active and moving the cursor to active.

buttons.label: Offset
buttons.tooltip: Move the selection to the cursor while keeping the selection offset.

buttons.label: Worigin
buttons.tooltip: Move the 3D cursor to the world origin.

buttons.label: slicer
buttons.tooltip: Slicer

buttons.label: alignment tools
buttons.tooltip: Selected objects go to the active-object min, center, max, surface, and origin alignment.

buttons.label: boolean
buttons.tooltip: Quick Boolean with I/U/D operation buttons, solver fanout, SI/HT/HC/S toggles, and Run.

buttons.label: flatten revolve
buttons.tooltip: Flatten the active mesh into a centered profile, hide the source object, and revolve the profile in place.

buttons.label: remesh
buttons.tooltip: Create, update, and apply Blender Remesh modifiers from a compact FlowCell tool set.

buttons.label: rotate
buttons.tooltip: rotate objects with, transform, and distribute(evenly spaced copies around pivot)

buttons.label: smart axis
buttons.tooltip: Smart Axis Lock stores selected object bounds, cycles pinned axis sides, and can run live while scaling.

buttons.label: theme
buttons.tooltip: Set Blender UI theme and HDRI values, plus Place Picture fake gizmos and fake grid over a background image.

buttons.label: tri poly
buttons.tooltip: Create triangle and regular polygon prism shapes from a compact Tri & Poly tool set.

buttons.label: xyz dimensions
buttons.tooltip: Show live X, Y, and Z dimensions for the active selected object in inches.
